title: Canada Post Stamp Price in 2026
description: A single stamp is $1.44 and a booklet stamp $1.24 for a letter up to 30 g. Current rates by weight, and what the proposed 2027 increase means.
keywords: how much is a stamp in canada
answer: A single Canada Post stamp costs $1.44 in 2026. Stamps bought in a booklet, coil or pane cost $1.24 each. Either one mails a standard letter up to 30 grams anywhere in Canada. Letters from 30 to 50 grams cost $1.75. These rates have applied since January 13, 2025.

blocks.p: A standard letter is an envelope or card no larger than 245 × 156 × 5 mm. Anything bigger or thicker is priced as non-standard or oversize; see [postage for a large envelope](/blog/postage-for-a-large-envelope-canada).

The January 13, 2025 increase moved the single stamp from $1.15 to $1.44, a rise of about 25%, and the booklet, coil and pane stamp from $0.99 to $1.24. Canada Post's price pages show the same rates today, and the 30 to 50 g rate is $1.75 for both kinds of stamp.

Canada Post's price guide defines the Permanent stamp as a non-denominated stamp with a postage value of $1.24, the same as the booklet price. See [what a Permanent stamp is worth](/blog/permanent-stamp-value-canada) for how that affects you.

News coverage of the November 2026 federal budget reports a plan to raise the domestic stamp to $2.00 in 2027. Canada Post's own price pages still show $1.44 and $1.24, so treat $2.00 as a proposal until Canada Post publishes a new rate. This page will be updated when it does.

blocks.note: Check the live figure on Canada Post's stamp price page before you buy in bulk; the numbers here are current as of this guide's date.

sections.h2: Do you need more than one stamp?

blocks.p: A standard letter up to 30 g needs one. Heavier or oversize letters need several; [how many stamps a letter needs](/blog/how-many-stamps-for-a-letter-in-canada) works through each weight band. If you would rather skip the stamp entirely, [sendletter](/) prints, stamps and mails a letter for you.
